body_text:
For any subspace $U \leq V$, its *annihilator* is the subspace of $V^*$
consisting of all linear functionals that vanish identically on $U$:
$$ U^\circ = \{\varphi \in V^* : \varphi(u) = 0 \text{ for all } u \in U\}. $$

Annihilators reverse inclusions: if $U_1 \subseteq U_2$, then $U_2^\circ \subseteq U_1^\circ$.
When $V$ is finite-dimensional, the dimension formula holds:
$$ \dim(U) + \dim(U^\circ) = \dim(V). $$
Through the canonical isomorphism $V \cong V^{**}$, the double annihilator
satisfies $(U^\circ)^\circ = U$.
